info.about: Futurama is a 3D platform video game based on the science fiction animated series of the same name. It was developed by Unique Development Studios and published by SCi Games in Europe and Oceania and by Vivendi Universal Games in North America for the PlayStation 2 and Xbox, both of which use cel-shading technology.
info.trivia: The show's original voice cast recorded the game, and series composer Christopher Tyng wrote its soundtrack.
info.why: It sold poorly and had a very limited print run, and the show's cancellation soon after release meant it was never reprinted, so it became one of the rarest PS2 discs.
